overall: The AG found the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law: no evidence of outside deliberation, and signing the denial order after an open-session vote was an administrative act.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board deliberated outside a posted meeting to reverse its executive-session straw vote and deny a physician's license.
allegations.key_passage: Accordingly, we find no evidence that the Board deliberated outside of a noticed meeting and therefore we find no violation of the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board issued a preliminary denial order it never voted on, implying the order was secretly approved outside a meeting.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the execution of the order outside of a meeting was an administrative task and not improper deliberation.
